items.title: Von Freeman — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I traveled with Chico all over the world for two or three years. ... Ronnie’s, that was with Chico’s band.

ctx.x: Yeah. I didn’t think that I was having a good night at all. He was just leaning on – he inspired me. He was leaning on to – I couldn’t understand what he was saying. He was speaking in Japanese. But he was just elated. He had his son with him. Then he
started following me and Chico. We was playing these different hours and places. I say, it’s so strange. I know he don’t know nothing about what I’m doing, musical.
